description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different categories within a dataset. There are seven slices in total, each corresponding to a different category. The categories are labeled as Math, Coding, Information Seeking, Reasoning, Planning, Creative Writing, and Others (combined). The Math category has the largest slice, accounting for 29.3% of the dataset, followed by Coding with 24.3%, and Information Seeking with 22.2%. Reasoning makes up 10.4%, while Planning and Creative Writing are the smallest slices, each with 2.3% and 2.2% respectively. The Others (combined) category accounts for 9.3% of the dataset. The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner, which lists the categories and their corresponding colors. The percentages are displayed inside the slices, and the chart does not appear to have any visually emphasized slices. The slices are ordered in descending size, starting with Math and ending with Others (combined).
